_comment: Pinned upstream content sources. Refresh via /bcq-update or by re-running scripts/vendor-<source>.sh.

review_prompts._note: FROZEN, not refreshed by vendor-bcapps.sh. BCApps deleted tools/Code Review/instructions/ in 30e2b18c (#8700, 2026-06-24) when its Copilot PR reviewer switched to the microsoft/BCQuality knowledge base (vendored under the bcquality key); the review engine then moved out of BCApps (770cf576, #9210) to microsoft/BC-ALAgents, which ships no per-domain prompts. ref is the last commit that had these files (parent of 30e2b18c); content is byte-identical to the dc1242e3 copies. Treat as supplementary to BCQuality.

al_docs._note: BCApps' MIT-licensed al-docs skill for hierarchical AL documentation generation. The Cursor adapter at skills/al-docs/SKILL.md routes init/update/audit modes to the corresponding reference file.

bcquality._note: Pinned to a SHA so findings carry stable references (DO references[].sha). content/bcquality mirrors the upstream repo layout.

microsoft_skills._note: al-code-review super-skill plus 19 leaves under review/

community_skills._note: al-agents-review (top-level peer, not composed by al-code-review)

tools._note: Runtime PowerShell helpers; Test-*.ps1 harnesses not vendored. knowledge-index.json/skill-index.json are generated and git-ignored.

custom_knowledge._note: Local plugin content, NOT vendored. Highest layer-precedence per READ. TAG articles: style (6), upgrade (1), web-services (1).

validator._note: 739-line upstream validator implementing rules R01..R29. Run via: python3 scripts/validate-bcquality-frontmatter.py --root content/bcquality

bcbench._note: Vendoring ONLY ALTest.agent.md, BC-Bench's only custom agent with published results: test-generation 62.4% vs 51.7% mean, pass^5 39.6% vs 22.8% (GitHub Copilot CLI + claude-opus-4-6, 101 tasks x 5 runs; ALTest arm 2026-04-21..23 at aa12acbe00167252aef2ea712dc1351d42770e1d, baseline 2026-05-06..11). Not re-measured on newer models or with Claude Code; claude-opus-4-8 without ALTest scored 60.8% (2026-06-17). Vendored text is the merged e484c2bc version (one line differs from the measured one), unchanged through 7c98b750. BC-Bench's code-review category also measures the six BCApps review instructions (src/bcbench/agent/shared/instructions/microsoft-BCApps/instructions/) at ~+20 F1 over no instructions; they are whitespace-identical to content/bcapps-review-prompts/ (frozen at BCApps 7040033d).
